name: Ezekiel's Temple
summary: The measured temple complex of Ezekiel's vision (Ezek 40-48) - under the project's framing (ADR 0012) a literal future millennial sanctuary in restored Israel, distinct from and adjacent to the New Jerusalem (Rev 21:22; Ezek 48:10).

measurements.notes: ESV prints '500 cubits by the measuring reed'. The Hebrew (and e.g. NASB) reads 500 REEDS (= 3,000 cubits) - a genuine translation-level dispute. Rendered per the ESV (500 cubits), which also closes the chapter's own arithmetic (50+100+50+100+100+100 = 500 east-west); see RENDERING-DECISIONS entry #7.
